\[
I_{\text{out}}(x,y) = \sum_{j=-r}^{r} \sum_{i=-r}^{r} w_i \, w_j \, I(x+i,\, y+j),
\qquad
w_i = \frac{r + 1 - \lvert i \rvert}{(r+1)^2},
\qquad
r = \frac{n-1}{2},
\quad
n = 5
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(I\): Input channel value
- \(I_{\text{out}}\): Output channel value
- \(n\): Window size in pixels, odd
- \(r\): Window radius in pixels
- \(w_i\): Normalized tent weight at offset i

The weights fall in a straight line from the center to the edge of the window and add up to 1. A triangle of width 2r + 1 is a box of width r + 1 convolved with itself, so the tent filter blurs like two box filters in a row. The 2D weight is the product of two 1D weights.
